Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to use time zone-agnostic fields in resource planning in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026.

How does this affect me?
Users will be able to set default start and end dates for resource requirements, resource bookings, and related tables without dates being converted based on time zone differences. This feature will also give environments flexibility to use time zone-independent date fields, helping maintain consistent dates for users working across multiple geographies.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Use time zone-agnostic fields in resource planning.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Use time zone-agnostic fields in resource planning
